maddeler.e:
أحترب (form VIII)
# أَحْتَرِبُ (ʔaḥtaribu) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
# أَحْتَرِبَ (ʔaḥtariba) /ʔaħ.ta.ri.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
# أَحْتَرِبْ (ʔaḥtarib) /ʔaħ.ta.rib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَرَبَ (iḥtaraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
